item.title: ‘ICC will have to accept’: Ex-Pakistan captain makes explosive claim amid PCB’s T20 World Cup boycott threat
item.description: Amid reports that Pakistan might boycott their clash against India in the T20 World Cup 2026, a former Pakistan skipper has said ICC will have to accept if the decision is made.

item.title: Mira Nair named in Epstein email: 2009 film bash at Ghislaine’s townhouse
item.description: Newly released Epstein files name filmmaker Mira Nair at Ghislaine Maxwell’s 2009 afterparty for her film Amelia. Publicist Peggy Siegal’s email to Epstein lists guests like Bill Clinton, Jeff Bezos. No wrongdoing alleged.

item.title: Budget 2026: Sunday at 11 am FM Sitharaman to present blueprint for growth, consumption
item.description: On Sunday, Feb 1, finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman will present the Union Budget for FY27. She will try to balance between growth and consumption on the one hand and fiscal discipline on the other. All the conflicting objectives are improtant on the road to a developed nation by 2047.

item.title: Rajamouli drops NEW jaw-dropping Varanasi poster: Asteroid annihilation heads to earth
item.description: SS Rajamouli unveiled a thrilling new Varanasi poster showing an asteroid crashing toward Earth. He captioned it: “April 7th, 2027… #VARANASI.” Stars Mahesh Babu (Rudhra) and Priyanka Chopra (Mandakini) shared it too. Delayed from January to dodge Spirit clash, the epic blends mythology, history, and sci-fi across timelines. Priyanka wrote: “So much love and excitement for this”

item.title: Latest Epstein files claim Bill Gates caught STD from Russian girls, secretly gave antibiotics to Melinda
item.description: Unverified claims about Bill Gates have emerged in newly released Jeffrey Epstein documents. According to emails Epstein allegedly wrote to himself in 2013, Gates is accused of contracting a sexually transmitted disease after relationships with Russian women and later requesting antibiotics that could be discreetly passed on to his then-wife, Melinda Gates. A spokesperson for Gates dismissed the allegations outright, calling them “absolutely absurd and completely false”.

item.title: Aryna Sabalenka vs Elena Rybakina, Australian Open 2026 final: Head to head, key stats & live streaming details
item.description: World no.1 Aryna Sabalenka will be eyeing her third Australian Open title when she takes on Elena Rybakina in the women’s singles final on Saturday. Here is all you need to know about the title clash.

item.title: ‘Cheap government’: Nikki Haley’s son triggers controversy with remarks on India
item.description: Nalin Haley, son of former South Carolina Governor Nikki Haley, has sparked controversy after calling the Indian government “cheap” and questioning India’s status as a reliable ally of the United States. His remarks, made in a social media post, come at a time when India and the US are engaged in discussions over a potential trade deal, drawing criticism and renewed attention to his past controversial statements.

item.title: Mumbai western suburbs affected by power outage for over an hour | Details
item.description: A number of areas in the western suburbs, including Khar West, Bandra West, Andheri West, Juhu, Malad West, Goregaon West, Kandivali West, Versova, Osiwara, Vile Parle and Lokhandwala, were impacted.

item.title: Ex-Google engineer Linwei Ding convicted in first-ever AI espionage case linked to China
item.description: A U.S. federal jury convicted former Google engineer Linwei Ding of stealing sensitive AI trade secrets to support China-linked ventures. Prosecutors said he copied thousands of confidential files covering chips, data centers, and AI supercomputer software while still employed.

item.title: ‘Not romance, it’s colonel’s look’: Salman roars at Battle of Galwan memes | WATCH
item.description: Salman Khan slammed trolls mocking his ‘romantic’ glance in Battle of Galwan teaser at an ISPL match in Surat. “Ab kisi ko ye samajh mein ata hai ki ye romantic look hai, lekin Colonel hu bhayya. To ye, Colonel ka look hai,” he clarified, stressing it’s about motivating soldiers.
